secrets.name: DATABASE_URL
secrets.description: Optional external PostgreSQL URL (e.g. Supabase transaction pooler). Leave unset to use the local compose PostgreSQL.

secrets.name: DIRECT_URL
secrets.description: Optional direct/session PostgreSQL URL used by Prisma CLI migrations against an external database. Leave unset to use the local compose PostgreSQL.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Server-only session secret. Reserved for future signed sessions; not read by the current code.

secrets.name: SMTP_HOST
secrets.description: SMTP server host for transactional email. Not used by the current code.

secrets.name: SMTP_PORT
secrets.description: SMTP server port for transactional email. Not used by the current code.

secrets.name: SMTP_USER
secrets.description: SMTP username for transactional email. Not used by the current code.

secrets.name: SMTP_PASS
secrets.description: SMTP password for transactional email. Not used by the current code.

secrets.name: SMTP_FROM
secrets.description: Sender address for transactional email. Not used by the current code.
